description: A new session. Its prompt is sent once it's begun.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

cwd.description: Its folder (default: the forked session's, else home).

account.description: The subscription its agent runs under, one of the host's accounts for its model's provider (Claude's or Codex's: Account's id or name; "" for the CLI's own sign-in), in place of the one it would take (the chat's that starts it, else the host's default for that provider). Refused for a model that runs on no subscription, or one that isn't an account there; a disabled one's refused as its chats are. Asks subscriptions_read of a member besides spawn.

attach.description: This connection's attached live to it first.

spawned_by.description: The id of the chat here whose mesh tools start it.

task_run.description: A task's run going here that starts it, as the run's environment names it (BAUDE_TASK_RUN, BAUDE_TASK_TOKEN): nested under its Bot (spawned_by), kept in the run's chats, judged as the member that ran it, and its first turn's end told its Bot. Refused if no run's going with that token.

add_dirs.description: Folders it may use besides its own (--add-dir).

fork_from.description: A session of this host's whose conversation this one starts as a copy of (--fork-session).

ask_timeout.description: Seconds a permission it asks waits while nobody who answers is attached, then ask_default answers it.

ask_default.description: What answers when ask_timeout runs out.

draft.description: A new chat, listed as draft and not kept till it's written in, and gone if nobody's attached before it is.

ephemeral.description: A side question's, forked from fork_from (or fresh), keeping nothing, never listed, gone with its last head.

adopt.description: A conversation claude has here already, by its id, made the host's.

env.description: A head on this machine's environment for the session's agent (kept in memory only).

start_key.description: An id the client picks, kept and listed, so it can tell whether a start whose answer it lost was taken.

app_tools.description: Names of MCP servers this head runs itself, for an agent here: each relayed back to it over this connection (mcp_open, mcp, mcp_close), allowed without asking.

grace.description: Seconds an ephemeral session waits for its head to come back (GRACE_MAX_S at most; else EPHEMERAL_S).

as_meta.description: As input's as_meta, for the prompt; the session is held to Auto at most, as a subagent of a chat is.

bot.description: A Bot made of it as it starts (a phone's host takes it; picture left out).
